lines.text: So the thing at the bottom of the first floor is dead, and it dropped a shard. Give it here. And sit down, you're bleeding on my floor.
It burrowed. And it had a pattern. Lunge, swipe, circle away. Every time, the same order.
Beasts don't keep patterns that clean. Hungry things improvise. Write it down exactly, I want the order and the count.
